7220000.en: Summon Spirit grants a unique buff to self depending on which spirit is active. Helen buffs self with 1 HP restored every 1 second, Fredrick buffs self with 1.1x damage of all sources, and Sebastian buffs self with 0.8x magic, fire, lightning, and holy damage taken
7220000.zh: 技藝（Summon Spirit）依當前出現的靈魂給予自身不同的獨特增益：Helen 使自身每 1 秒恢復 1 HP；Fredrick 使自身所有來源的傷害 ×1.1；Sebastian 使自身受到的魔力、火、雷、聖屬性傷害 ×0.8。
